title: [Master]-Sales or purchase order with 100% prepayment: Prepmt. Line Amount drifts below Prepmt. Amt. Inv. after partial invoices, so the order can't be released or posted
summary: Prepayment line amount drift is fixed for sales and purchase orders with 100% prepayment by correcting rounding calculations after partial invoicing, allowing orders to be released and posted successfully.
key_points: Corrects rounding logic when calculating prepayment line amounts during partial invoice scenarios
Applies fix across all localized versions of Sales Line and Purchase Line tables
Prevents prepayment line amounts from drifting below the invoiced prepayment amounts
Adds test cases for full prepayment rounding scenarios in both purchases and sales
Resolves blocking issue preventing order release and posting with 100% prepayment
